descriptionByLocale.fr:
Présentation
Le département d'ingénierie (EN) fournit au CERN l'expertise technique, les systèmes d'infrastructure et la coordination technique nécessaires à la conception, à l'installation, à l'exploitation, à l'entretien et au démontage du complexe d'accélérateurs du CERN et de ses installations expérimentales.
Ce poste fait partie du groupe d'ingénierie des transports et de la manutention (EN-THE), qui est chargé de préparer, d'organiser et de coordonner toutes les opérations de transport et de manutention des accélérateurs et des expériences du CERN. Le Groupe gère également chaque année le transport de milliers d'articles conventionnels et non conventionnels, ainsi que de produits chimiques et radioactifs.
En tant qu'ingénieur technique en EN-THE, vous faites partie de la Section Maintenance de l'équipement de manutention (EN-HE-HEM), qui gère et maintient tous les équipements de transport, de manutention et de levage industriels pour assurer une performance fiable tout au long de son cycle de vie.
Fonctions
En tant qu'ingénieur technique de la section EN-THE-HEM, vous ferez partie d'une équipe de 10 personnes (ingénieurs techniques et techniciens) en charge de la fourniture, de la mise en service et de l'entretien des camions industriels au CERN. Vous:

• Gérer le parc d'équipement, les contrats d'entretien connexes et la planification des ressources, en assurant la disponibilité, la fiabilité et le respect des exigences opérationnelles.

• Superviser les activités des entrepreneurs sur place, en assurant le plein respect des règles de sécurité et des exigences techniques tout au long de l'exécution.

• Tenir à jour la documentation technique exacte, y compris les spécifications, les dessins, les dossiers d'équipement et les données de configuration.

• Développer et optimiser les stratégies de maintenance, surveiller les performances de la flotte à l'aide des outils Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) et contribuer à l'amélioration continue, à la modernisation et aux programmes de gestion des actifs à long terme.

• Gérer les activités d'approvisionnement dans le cadre des contrats d'approvisionnement et d'entretien existants, y compris passer des commandes et assurer l'alignement sur les spécifications techniques.
Serait considéré comme un actif:

• Contribuer à la préparation des spécifications, des achats, de la mise en service et de l'entretien des véhicules de transport spéciaux au CERN, en mettant fortement l'accent sur l'équipement personnalisé pour les activités de transport souterrain et de manutention.

• Contribuer à la définition des exigences techniques ainsi qu'à la conception et au développement de véhicules industriels et personnalisés en préparant des spécifications techniques détaillées, en étroite collaboration avec les utilisateurs, les services techniques et les fournisseurs.

Baccalauréat ou expérience pertinente équivalente dans le domaine de la mécanique ou de l'électromécanique ou un domaine connexe.

Expérience :

• Expérience démontrée dans la maintenance et la mise en service d'un large éventail de camions industriels standard et personnalisés.

• Expérience éprouvée dans la gestion des contrats et la supervision sur place des contrats (entretien) de camions industriels.

• Expérience éprouvée dans l'utilisation des outils EAM.

• L'expérience des systèmes électriques et de contrôle serait un atout.
Compétences techniques:

• Gestion de l'entretien.

• Exploitation et entretien du système de transport et du matériel de manutention.

• Mise en service de camions industriels standard et personnalisés.

• Connaissance des systèmes EAM.

• La connaissance des systèmes de contrôle serait un atout.
Compétences comportementales :

• Atteindre des résultats : fournir un travail de haute qualité dans les délais et répondre aux attentes.

• Démontrer la souplesse : s'adapter rapidement et avec ressources à l'évolution des priorités et des besoins.

• Résoudre les problèmes : anticiper les obstacles; évaluer d'autres solutions afin d'avoir un plan de repli.

• Travailler en équipe : bien travailler en groupe et s'intégrer facilement dans une équipe; participer pleinement et jouer un rôle actif dans les activités de l'équipe.

Anglais parlé et écrit, avec un engagement à apprendre le français.

jobs.title: Industrial Controls Technician (EN-EL-CBS-2026-187-GRAE)
jobs.description:
We are looking for an Electrical Controls Technical Engineer focused on industrial control systems and SCADA infrastructure in an electrical engineering environment. You would support the installation, engineering, cabling, configuration, commissioning, and maintenance of electrical control and monitoring systems used to supervise CERN electrical distribution network for HL-LHC . Typical equipment includes power and signal converters, network switches, Remote Terminal Units (RTUs), remote input/output units, communication buses and field devices.
 As Electrical Controls technician in the Electrical Engineering Group, you will actively contribute to the installation, engineering, cabling and commissioning of controls equipment, including power and signal converters, network switches, remote acquisition units and terminal units required for the supervision of electrical equipment, as part of a SCADA system for the supervision of the CERN electrical power network. The job will also require coordination of contractor technicians for on-site activities, diagnosis and troubleshooting of controls equipment and communication bus faults, production of relevant technical documentation and reports.
 Your responsibilities:

• Installation and commissioning of industrial controls equipment (WAGO remote I/O stations, switches, timeservers, protocol gateways..) and of electrical equipment integrated in the control and supervision system.

• Configuration of SCADA and data acquisition systems.

• Preparation of technical files for patch-panel cabling and remote I/O station wiring.

• Supervision of contractor personnel for work-site cabling and installation activities.
 Your profile:

• Demonstrated practical knowledge in installation and commissioning of industrial controls equipment.

• Execution and supervision of signal cabling, functional testing.

• Troubleshooting of controls hardware faults.

• Practical knowledge of industrial communication protocols, setting and troubleshooting (e.g. Modbus TCP/IP , IEC 60870-5-104, IEC-61850...).

• Coordination of contractors for work-site and data engineering activities.

• Practical knowledge of basic electrical wiring, reading electrical schematics and using multimeters.
 Skills:

• Knowledge of installation, engineering and testing of SCADA and acquisition systems.

• Knowledge of serial or Ethernet based fieldbus troubleshooting.

• Basic knowledge in programming of PLC systems.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
 Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Electrical / Industrial Engineering (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is a general secondary education diploma .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants with a Bachelor's, Master's or PhD degree are not eligible.

Job closing date: 02.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
 Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
 Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
 Target start date: 01-September-2026
 This position involves:

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.
 Job reference: EN-EL-CBS-2026-187-GRAE
 Field of work: Electrical or Electronics Engineering
 Benchmark job: 300040 - Electrical Technician

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend of 4687 Swiss Francs per month (tax free).

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Stiamo cercando un ingegnere tecnico di controllo elettrico focalizzato su sistemi di controllo industriale e infrastrutture SCADA in un ambiente di ingegneria elettrica. Si supporta l'installazione, l'ingegneria, il cablaggio, la configurazione, la messa in servizio e la manutenzione di sistemi di controllo e monitoraggio elettrici utilizzati per supervisionare la rete di distribuzione elettrica CERN per HL-LHC . L'attrezzatura tipica comprende convertitori di potenza e segnale, interruttori di rete, unità terminali remoti (RTU), unità di ingresso/uscita remoti, bus di comunicazione e dispositivi di campo.
In qualità di tecnico di controllo elettrico nel gruppo di ingegneria elettrica, contribuirai attivamente all'installazione, all'ingegneria, al cablaggio e alla messa in servizio di apparecchiature di controllo, inclusi convertitori di potenza e segnale, interruttori di rete, unità di acquisizione remota e unità terminali necessarie per la supervisione di apparecchiature elettriche, nell'ambito di un sistema SCADA per la supervisione della rete elettrica CERN. Il lavoro richiederà anche il coordinamento dei tecnici degli appaltatori per le attività in loco, la diagnosi e la risoluzione dei problemi delle apparecchiature di controllo e dei guasti dei bus di comunicazione, la produzione di documentazione tecnica e report rilevanti.
Le tue responsabilità:

• Installazione e messa in servizio di apparecchiature di controllo industriale (stazioni di I/O remoto, interruttori, timeserver, gateway di protocollo..) e di apparecchiature elettriche integrate nel sistema di controllo e supervisione.

• Configurazione di SCADA e sistemi di acquisizione dati.

• Preparazione di file tecnici per il cablaggio patch-panel e il cablaggio remoto della stazione I/O.

• Supervisione del personale di appalto per attività di cablaggio e installazione del cantiere.
Il tuo profilo:

• Conoscenza pratica dimostrata nell'installazione e nella messa in servizio di apparecchiature di controllo industriale.

• Esecuzione e supervisione del cablaggio del segnale, test funzionali.

• Risoluzione dei problemi dei controlli guasti hardware.

• Conoscenza pratica dei protocolli di comunicazione industriale, impostazione e risoluzione dei problemi (ad esempio Modbus TCP/IP , IEC 60870-5-104, IEC-61850...).

• Coordinamento degli appaltatori per attività di cantiere e di ingegneria dei dati.

• Conoscenza pratica del cablaggio elettrico di base, la lettura di schemi elettrici e l'utilizzo di multimetri.
Competenze:

• Conoscenza dell'installazione, dell'ingegneria e dei test di SCADA e dei sistemi di acquisizione.

• Conoscenza della risoluzione dei problemi del fieldbus seriale o Ethernet.

• Conoscenza di base nella programmazione dei sistemi PLC.

• Parlato e scritto inglese, con un impegno per imparare il francese.
Criteri di ammissibilità:

• Sei un cittadino di uno Stato membro del CERN o di uno Stato membro associato .

• Con il termine di applicazione, hai un massimo di due anni di esperienza professionale dalla laurea in Ingegneria elettrica / industriale (o un campo correlato) e la tua più alta qualifica educativa è un diploma di istruzione secondaria generale.

• Non hai mai avuto un contratto di laurea o di socio del CERN.

• I candidati con una laurea, Master o dottorato di ricerca non sono ammissibili.

Data di chiusura del lavoro: 02.08.2026 alle 23:59 CEST.
Durata del contratto: 24 mesi, con una possibile estensione fino a 36 mesi massimo.
Flessibilità del lavoro: Fully Onsite
Data di inizio obiettivo: 01-September-2026
Questa posizione comporta:

• Interventi in impianti sotterranei.

• Una patente di guida valida.

Campo di lavoro: Ingegneria elettrica o elettronica

Vantaggi globali

• Sospensione mensile di 4687 franchi svizzeri al mese (tassa libera).

• 30 giorni di congedo retribuito all'anno più 2 settimane di chiusura annuale.

• Copertura dell’assicurazione sanitaria completa del CERN (per te, il tuo coniuge e i tuoi figli) e dell’iscrizione al CERN Pension Fund.

• Indennità mensili di famiglia, bambino e bambino a seconda delle circostanze individuali.

Panoramica del CERN - Scopri un mondo in cui l'impossibile è reso possibile!
Al CERN, l'Organizzazione europea per la ricerca nucleare, stiamo spingendo le frontiere della scienza e della tecnologia. Il nostro lavoro innovativo riunisce non solo i fisici, ma anche una vasta gamma di professionisti provenienti da settori ingegneristici, tecnici, scientifici e amministrativi. Insieme, promuoviamo un ambiente in cui l'innovazione e la collaborazione prosperano.
Ogni giorno, affrontiamo nuove sfide e opportunità entusiasmanti per contribuire alla ricerca all'avanguardia che plasma la nostra comprensione dell'universo. descriptionByLocale.en:
We are looking for an Electrical Controls Technical Engineer focused on industrial control systems and SCADA infrastructure in an electrical engineering environment. You would support the installation, engineering, cabling, configuration, commissioning, and maintenance of electrical control and monitoring systems used to supervise CERN electrical distribution network for HL-LHC . Typical equipment includes power and signal converters, network switches, Remote Terminal Units (RTUs), remote input/output units, communication buses and field devices.
As Electrical Controls technician in the Electrical Engineering Group, you will actively contribute to the installation, engineering, cabling and commissioning of controls equipment, including power and signal converters, network switches, remote acquisition units and terminal units required for the supervision of electrical equipment, as part of a SCADA system for the supervision of the CERN electrical power network. The job will also require coordination of contractor technicians for on-site activities, diagnosis and troubleshooting of controls equipment and communication bus faults, production of relevant technical documentation and reports.
Your responsibilities:

• Installation and commissioning of industrial controls equipment (WAGO remote I/O stations, switches, timeservers, protocol gateways..) and of electrical equipment integrated in the control and supervision system.

• Configuration of SCADA and data acquisition systems.

• Preparation of technical files for patch-panel cabling and remote I/O station wiring.

• Supervision of contractor personnel for work-site cabling and installation activities.
Your profile:

• Demonstrated practical knowledge in installation and commissioning of industrial controls equipment.

• Execution and supervision of signal cabling, functional testing.

• Troubleshooting of controls hardware faults.

• Practical knowledge of industrial communication protocols, setting and troubleshooting (e.g. Modbus TCP/IP , IEC 60870-5-104, IEC-61850...).

• Coordination of contractors for work-site and data engineering activities.

• Practical knowledge of basic electrical wiring, reading electrical schematics and using multimeters.
Skills:

• Knowledge of installation, engineering and testing of SCADA and acquisition systems.

• Knowledge of serial or Ethernet based fieldbus troubleshooting.

• Basic knowledge in programming of PLC systems.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Electrical / Industrial Engineering (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is a general secondary education diploma .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants with a Bachelor's, Master's or PhD degree are not eligible.

Job closing date: 02.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
Target start date: 01-September-2026
This position involves:

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.
Job reference: EN-EL-CBS-2026-187-GRAE
Field of work: Electrical or Electronics Engineering
Benchmark job: 300040 - Electrical Technician

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend of 4687 Swiss Francs per month (tax free).

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Nous recherchons un ingénieur technique des commandes électriques axé sur les systèmes de commande industrielle et l'infrastructure SCADA dans un environnement de génie électrique. Vous prendrez en charge l'installation, l'ingénierie, le câblage, la configuration, la mise en service et l'entretien des systèmes de commande et de surveillance électriques utilisés pour superviser le réseau de distribution électrique du CERN pour HL-LHC. L'équipement typique comprend les convertisseurs de puissance et de signal, les commutateurs réseau, les unités terminaux à distance (UTR), les unités d'entrée/sortie à distance, les bus de communication et les dispositifs de terrain.
En tant que technicien des commandes électriques du Groupe de l'ingénierie électrique, vous participerez activement à l'installation, à l'ingénierie, au câblage et à la mise en service des équipements de commande, y compris les convertisseurs de puissance et de signal, les commutateurs réseau, les unités d'acquisition à distance et les unités terminales nécessaires à la supervision des équipements électriques, dans le cadre d'un système SCADA pour la supervision du réseau électrique du CERN. Ce travail nécessitera également la coordination des techniciens contractuels pour les activités sur place, le diagnostic et le dépannage du matériel de contrôle et des pannes d'autobus de communication, la production de documents techniques et de rapports pertinents.
Vos responsabilités :

• Installation et mise en service d'équipements de commande industrielle (postes d'E/S à distance, commutateurs, serveurs de temps, passerelles de protocole) et d'équipements électriques intégrés dans le système de contrôle et de supervision.

• Configuration des systèmes SCADA et d'acquisition de données.

• Préparation de fichiers techniques pour le câblage de panneaux de patch et le câblage de station d'E/S à distance.

• Supervision du personnel de l'entrepreneur pour les activités de câblage et d'installation sur chantier.
Votre profil:

• Connaissances pratiques démontrées en matière d'installation et de mise en service d'équipements de contrôle industriel.

• Exécution et supervision du câblage des signaux, essais fonctionnels.

• Dépannage des défauts matériels de contrôle.

• Connaissance pratique des protocoles de communication industrielle, de réglage et de dépannage (p. ex. Modbus TCP/IP , CEI 60870-5-104, CEI-61850...).

• Coordination des entrepreneurs pour les activités de chantier et d'ingénierie des données.

• Connaissance pratique du câblage électrique de base, lecture des schémas électriques et utilisation de multimètres.
Compétences :

• Connaissance de l'installation, de l'ingénierie et des essais des systèmes SCADA et d'acquisition.

• Connaissance du dépannage des bus de terrain en série ou Ethernet.

• Connaissances de base dans la programmation des systèmes PLC.

• Anglais parlé et écrit, avec un engagement à apprendre le français.
Critères d'éligibilité:

• Vous êtes ressortissant d'un État membre ou associé du CERN .

• À la date limite de présentation des candidatures, vous disposez d'un maximum de deux ans d'expérience professionnelle depuis votre diplôme en génie électrique/industriel (ou dans un domaine connexe) et votre diplôme d'études supérieures est un diplôme d'enseignement secondaire général.

This includes beam-pipe support structures, tracker bulkheads, beam-luminosity and beam-background monitors, and their associated services. The work will culminate in the equipment installation and commissioning at the end of the Long Shutdown 3 of the LHC.
 Functions:

• Prepare 3D models and technical drawings and perform thermo-mechanical analyses of complex mechanical components and assemblies.

• Contribute to component procurement and oversee fabrication of mechanical parts, including related quality assurance.

• Lead and supervise the assembly of mock-ups, prototypes, and final versions of support structures for the CMS innermost region.

• Assist with the integration and testing of the Inner Tracker and Luminosity Monitors at CERN.

• Support and supervise colleagues from collaborating institutes participating in integration activities at CERN.

Master's Degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

• Proven experience in design of complex mechanical components and assemblies using 3D CAD tools.

• Experience with structural and thermal simulations using finite-element analysis.

• Experience in construction, assembly, and quality control of mechanical systems.

• Demonstrated ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary team, establishing and maintaining constructive and effective working relationships with a diverse range of colleagues.

• Design and analysis of mechanical structures.

• Production of 2D drawings and 3D models.

• Knowledge and application of numerical modelling in solid mechanics.

• Manufacturing of mechanical parts.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction:
You will play a key role in the design, prototyping, construction, and integration of the mechanical structures and services for the innermost region of the CMS detector at CERN. This includes beam-pipe support structures, tracker bulkheads, beam-luminosity and beam-background monitors, and their associated services. The work will culminate in the equipment installation and commissioning at the end of the Long Shutdown 3 of the LHC.
Functions:

• Prepare 3D models and technical drawings and perform thermo-mechanical analyses of complex mechanical components and assemblies.

• Contribute to component procurement and oversee fabrication of mechanical parts, including related quality assurance.

• Lead and supervise the assembly of mock-ups, prototypes, and final versions of support structures for the CMS innermost region.

• Assist with the integration and testing of the Inner Tracker and Luminosity Monitors at CERN.

• Support and supervise colleagues from collaborating institutes participating in integration activities at CERN.

Master's Degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
Experience:

• Proven experience in design of complex mechanical components and assemblies using 3D CAD tools.

• Experience with structural and thermal simulations using finite-element analysis.

• Experience in construction, assembly, and quality control of mechanical systems.

• Demonstrated ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary team, establishing and maintaining constructive and effective working relationships with a diverse range of colleagues.
Technical competencies:

• Design and analysis of mechanical structures.

• Production of 2D drawings and 3D models.

• Knowledge and application of numerical modelling in solid mechanics.

• Manufacturing of mechanical parts.
Behavioural competencies:

• Working in Teams: building and maintaining constructive and effective work relationships.

• Learning and Sharing Knowledge: sharing knowledge and expertise freely and willingly with others; coaching others to ensure knowledge transfer.

• Bringing the Best out of People: creating a common mind-set and promoting team spirit.
Language skills:

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility and closing date:
Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 12.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Employment Conditions:
Contract type: Limited duration contract (4 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
Working Hours: 40 hours per week
Job Flexibility: Fully Onsite
This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Shift work, when required by the needs of the Organization.
Job grade: 6-7
Job reference: EP-CMS-ID-2026-152-LD
Field of work: Mechanical Engineering
Benchmark Job Title: Mechanical Engineer

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
More information about us, here: careers.cern
descriptionByLocale.de:
Einleitung:
Sie spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei Design, Prototyping, Konstruktion und Integration der mechanischen Strukturen und Dienstleistungen für den innersten Bereich des CMS-Detektors am CERN. Dazu gehören Trägerstrukturen für Strahlrohre, Trackerschotten, Monitore für Strahlluminosität und Hintergrund und die zugehörigen Dienste. Die Arbeiten werden in der Installation und Inbetriebnahme der Ausrüstung am Ende des Long Shutdown 3 des LHC gipfeln.
Funktionen:

• Bereiten Sie 3D-Modelle und technische Zeichnungen vor und führen Sie thermomechanische Analysen komplexer mechanischer Komponenten und Baugruppen durch.

• Beitrag zur Beschaffung von Komponenten und Überwachung der Herstellung von mechanischen Teilen, einschließlich der damit verbundenen Qualitätssicherung.

• Führen und beaufsichtigen Sie die Montage von Modellen, Prototypen und endgültigen Versionen der Stützstrukturen für die innerste Region des CMS.

• Unterstützung bei der Integration und dem Testen der Inner Tracker und Luminosity Monitore am CERN.

• Unterstützung und Betreuung von Kollegen aus kooperierenden Instituten, die an Integrationsaktivitäten am CERN teilnehmen.

Master-Abschluss oder gleichwertige einschlägige Erfahrung im Bereich Maschinenbau oder einem verwandten Bereich.
Erfahrung:

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Design komplexer mechanischer Komponenten und Baugruppen mit 3D-CAD-Tools.

• Erfahrung mit strukturellen und thermischen Simulationen mit Finite-Elemente-Analyse.

• Erfahrung in Konstruktion, Montage und Qualitätskontrolle von mechanischen Systemen.

• Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, effektiv in einem multidisziplinären Team zu arbeiten und konstruktive und effektive Arbeitsbeziehungen mit einer Vielzahl von Kollegen aufzubauen und aufrechtzuerhalten.
Technische Kompetenzen:

• Design und Analyse von mechanischen Strukturen.

• Herstellung von 2D-Zeichnungen und 3D-Modellen.

• Kenntnisse und Anwendung der numerischen Modellierung in der Festkörpermechanik.

• Herstellung von mechanischen Teilen.
Verhaltenskompetenzen:

• Arbeiten in Teams: Aufbau und Pflege konstruktiver und effektiver Arbeitsbeziehungen.

• Lernen und Teilen von Wissen: Wissen und Fachwissen frei und bereitwillig mit anderen teilen; andere coachen, um den Wissenstransfer zu gewährleisten.

• Das Beste aus den Menschen herausholen: eine gemeinsame Denkweise schaffen und den Teamgeist fördern.
Sprachkenntnisse:

• Englisch gesprochen und geschrieben, mit der Verpflichtung, Französisch zu lernen.

Förderfähigkeit und Stichtag:
Vielfalt ist seit ihrer Gründung ein integraler Bestandteil der Mission des CERN und ist ein fester Wert der Organisation. Die Beschäftigung einer vielfältigen Belegschaft ist zentral für unseren Erfolg. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen aus allen Mitgliedstaaten und assoziierten Mitgliedstaaten.
Diese freie Stelle wird so schnell wie möglich besetzt, und Anträge sollten uns normalerweise spätestens am 12.08.2026 um 23:59 Uhr erreichen.
Beschäftigungsbedingungen:
Vertragsart: Befristeter Vertrag (4 Jahre). Unter bestimmten Bedingungen können Inhaber von befristeten Verträgen eine unbefristete Position beantragen.
Arbeitszeit: 40 Stunden pro Woche
Arbeitsplatzflexibilität: Vollständig vor Ort
Diese Position umfasst:

• Arbeiten in Strahlungsgebieten.

• Eingriffe in unterirdische Anlagen.

• Ein gültiger Führerschein.

• Arbeiten in den Nächten, Sonntagen und offiziellen Feiertagen, wenn es die Bedürfnisse der Organisation erfordern.

• Schichtarbeit, wenn es die Bedürfnisse der Organisation erfordern.
Job Grade: 6-7
Berufsbezeichnung: EP-CMS-ID-2026-152-LD
Arbeitsgebiet: Maschinenbau
Benchmark Job Title: Maschinenbauingenieur

Globale Vorteile

• Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt (steuerfrei), das im Einklang mit Ihrer jahrelangen relevanten Erfahrung steigt.

• 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub pro Jahr plus 2 Wochen jährliche Schließung.

• Deckung durch die umfassende Krankenversicherung des CERN (für Sie, Ihren Ehepartner und Ihre Kinder) und die Mitgliedschaft in der CERN-Pensionskasse.

• Familien-, Kinder- und Säuglingszulagen, abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.

• Ein Umzugspaket (Installationszuschuss, Umzug, Reisekosten) abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.

• Möglichkeit, Ihren Vertrag bis zu 8 Jahre zu verlängern + Anspruch auf unbefristete Vertragsdauer.
Überblick über CERN - Entdecken Sie eine Welt, in der das Unmögliche möglich gemacht wird!
Bei CERN, der Europäischen Organisation für Kernforschung, erweitern wir die Grenzen von Wissenschaft und Technologie. Unsere bahnbrechende Arbeit bringt nicht nur Physiker, sondern auch eine Vielzahl von Fachleuten aus den Bereichen Ingenieurwesen, Technik, Wissenschaft und Verwaltung zusammen. Gemeinsam fördern wir ein Umfeld, in dem Innovation und Zusammenarbeit gedeihen.
Jeden Tag stehen wir vor spannenden neuen Herausforderungen und Möglichkeiten, einen Beitrag zur Spitzenforschung zu leisten, die unser Verständnis des Universums prägt. Wir begegnen diesen Herausforderungen durch die vielfältigen Perspektiven in unseren Teams, stellen sicher, dass jeder Beitrag wertgeschätzt wird und fördern unser gemeinsames Gefühl von Inklusion und Zweck. Vielfalt ist seit ihrer Gründung ein zentraler Wert des CERN und bleibt für unsere Mission und unseren anhaltenden Erfolg von zentraler Bedeutung.
Wenn Sie bereit sind, Teil einer dynamischen, integrativen Gemeinschaft zu sein, die die Grenzen des Wissens überschreitet, ist CERN der Ort, an dem Ihre Neugier und Ihre Fähigkeiten gedeihen können. Seien Sie Teil unserer Mission, das aufzudecken, was im Herzen des Universums liegt! TEIL!
Mehr Informationen über uns, hier: careers.cern
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Introduction:
Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la conception, le prototypage, la construction et l'intégration des structures et services mécaniques pour la région la plus intérieure du détecteur CMS au CERN. Cela comprend les structures de support du faisceau-tube, les cloisons des traqueurs, les moniteurs de lumière du faisceau et du faisceau-arrière-plan et leurs services connexes. Les travaux aboutiront à l'installation et à la mise en service de l'équipement à la fin de la longue coupure 3 du LHC.
Fonctions:

• Préparer des modèles 3D et des dessins techniques et effectuer des analyses thermomécaniques de composants et assemblages mécaniques complexes.

• Contribuer à l'acquisition de composants et superviser la fabrication de pièces mécaniques, y compris l'assurance de la qualité connexe.

• Diriger et superviser l'assemblage de maquettes, de prototypes et de versions finales de structures de soutien pour la région la plus intérieure de la CMS.

• Aider à l'intégration et à l'essai des moniteurs de suivi interne et de luminosité au CERN.

• Soutenir et superviser les collègues des instituts collaborateurs participant aux activités d'intégration au CERN.

Maîtrise ou expérience équivalente pertinente dans le domaine du génie mécanique ou dans un domaine connexe.
Expérience :

• Expérience éprouvée dans la conception de composants mécaniques complexes et d'assemblages utilisant des outils CAO 3D.

• Expérience des simulations structurales et thermiques à l'aide d'une analyse par éléments finis.

• Expérience dans la construction, le montage et le contrôle de la qualité des systèmes mécaniques.

• Capacité démontrée de travailler efficacement au sein d'une équipe multidisciplinaire, en établissant et en maintenant des relations de travail constructives et efficaces avec divers collègues.
Compétences techniques:

• Conception et analyse des structures mécaniques.

• Production de dessins 2D et de modèles 3D.

• Connaissance et application de la modélisation numérique en mécanique solide.

• Fabrication de pièces mécaniques.
Compétences comportementales :

• Travailler en équipe : établir et maintenir des relations de travail constructives et efficaces.

• Apprentissage et partage des connaissances : partage des connaissances et de l'expertise librement et volontairement avec les autres; coaching des autres pour assurer le transfert des connaissances.

• Faire sortir le meilleur des gens : créer un état d'esprit commun et promouvoir l'esprit d'équipe.
Compétences linguistiques :

• Anglais parlé et écrit, avec un engagement à apprendre le français.

Admissibilité et date de clôture:
La diversité fait partie intégrante de la mission du CERN depuis sa fondation et constitue une valeur établie pour l'Organisation. Notre réussite repose sur l'emploi d'une main-d'oeuvre diversifiée. Nous accueillons favorablement les candidatures de tous les États membres et États membres associés .
Cette vacance sera comblée dès que possible, et les candidatures devraient normalement nous parvenir au plus tard à 12h08.2026 à 23h59 CEST.
Conditions d'emploi:
Type de contrat: Contrat à durée limitée (4 ans). Sous réserve de certaines conditions, les titulaires de contrats à durée limitée peuvent demander un poste indéfini.
Heures de travail: 40 heures par semaine
Flexibilité de l'emploi : Entièrement sur place
Cette position implique:

• Travail dans les zones de rayonnement.

• Interventions dans des installations souterraines.

• Un permis de conduire valide.

• Travaille pendant les nuits, les dimanches et les jours fériés, lorsque les besoins de l ' Organisation l ' exigent.

• Travail posté, lorsque les besoins de l ' Organisation l ' exigent.

Référence du poste: EP-CMS-ID-2026-152-LD
Domaine de travail: Génie mécanique

Avantages globaux

Chaque jour, nous faisons face à de nouveaux défis passionnants et à de nouvelles occasions de contribuer à la recherche de pointe qui façonne notre compréhension de l'univers. Nous relevons ces défis grâce aux diverses perspectives au sein de nos équipes, en veillant à ce que chaque contribution soit valorisée et à ce que notre sens commun de l'inclusion et de l'objectif soit déterminé. Si vous êtes prêt à faire partie d'une communauté dynamique et inclusive qui repousse les limites du savoir, le CERN est l'endroit où votre curiosité et vos compétences peuvent prospérer. Faites partie de notre mission de découvrir ce qui est au cœur de l'univers ! S'il vous plaît !

jobs.title: Backend Python Engineer (OSI-SIS-TS-2026-128-GRAP)
jobs.description:
You will join the Tools and Services section within the Scientific Information Service, the team responsible for the platforms that power scientific discovery and open access across the High Energy Physics community. Our systems include INSPIRE, the global literature hub for particle physics; SCOAP3, which funds and tracks open access publishing; CERN Analysis Preservation, which safeguards the analyses behind physics results; and a tool facilitating access to CERN's institutional memory.
 As a Backend Python Engineer you will design, build and operate the services that ingest, curate, search and expose millions of scientific records to a worldwide audience. You will work on high throughput data pipelines, REST APIs, search infrastructure and the integration of AI driven retrieval into production systems. Your code will be open source and used daily by researchers across hundreds of institutes.
 As part of the Tools and Services team, you will drive the modernisation and evolution of the Scientific Information Service content platform. You will advance the backend services behind INSPIRE, SCOAP3 and CERN Analysis Preservation, expand Model Context Protocol services that open the team's scientific content to AI clients, and evaluate the harmonisation of the INSPIRE backend with the newer backoffice stack. This is a defined project to strengthen the platform's discovery, interoperability and AI driven access.
 Your responsibilities

• The core responsibility of this position is to drive the modernisation of the INSPIRE backend, expand the team's Model Context Protocol services, and align the digitisation and archival services with the team's technology stack, delivering a large scale migration to the Access to Memory (AtoM) service.
 INSPIRE backend and harmonisation:

• Review the remaining custom harvests, approximately 1000, and migrate those that should be retained to Apache Airflow, retiring or redesigning the rest.

• Work with curators throughout to decide what to keep, and automate the pipeline where evaluation shows it adds value, keeping a human in the loop for decisions that require expert judgement.

• Evolve the Apache Airflow ingestion and curation pipelines that process scientific metadata and full text at scale, improving data quality, deduplication, enrichment and source coverage.
 AI access and interoperability:

• Expand the team's Model Context Protocol services across INSPIRE, the library and other team services, moving them from pilot to a consistent, documented and maintainable interface that opens curated scientific content to external AI clients.

• Develop and optimise the search and discovery functionality on OpenSearch that underpins these features, including relevance tuning and indexing strategies.
 Digitisation and archival services:

• Align the digitisation and archival services with the team's technology stack, modernising them onto common frameworks and deployment tooling.

• Deliver and oversee the migration of 35 000 new archival items to the Access to Memory (AtoM) service across 2027, maintaining consistent metadata and data quality throughout.

• Develop and automate the connection between the connected services, enabling content to flow reliably across the digitisation and archival systems.

• Prepare the ingestion pipelines for new file ingestion, harmonising them with the team's other applications.
 Engineering foundations:

• Design, document and deliver REST APIs consumed by internal applications, partner institutes and third party tools.

• Apply automated testing, code review, monitoring and CI and CD, and support production through containerised deployments and performance tuning.

• Contribute the team's outputs back to the open source community to advance Open Science.
 Your profile

• Demonstrated experience building and operating backend services in Python in a production environment. Solid track record with web frameworks such as Django, Flask or FastAPI and with relational and document databases.

• Hands on experience designing REST APIs.

• Practical experience with search engines such as OpenSearch, including indexing and relevance tuning.

• Familiarity with containerised deployments, version control with Git and CI and CD workflows.

• Experience contributing to open source projects and working in a collaborative engineering team is highly valued.
 Skills

• Strong proficiency in Python and modern backend development practices, including frameworks such as Django, Flask and FastAPI.

• Solid understanding of REST API design, asynchronous programming and software testing.

• Experience with SQL data stores such as PostgreSQL and with search technologies such as OpenSearch.

• Working knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes and CI and CD pipelines.

• Understanding metadata standards and large scale data processing.

• Ability to write clean, well documented and maintainable code.

• Strong problem solving skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to work in a multicultural team and a collaborative, ownership driven mindset.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
 Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You have a professional background in Computer Science (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Job closing date: 06.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
 Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
 Working hours: 40 hours per week
 Job flexibility: Hybrid
 Target start date: 01-November-2026
 Job reference: OSI-SIS-TS-2026-128-GRAP
 Field of work: Software Engineering and IT
 Benchmark job: 200020 - Computing Engineer

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend between 6372-7004 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
 Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
 At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
 Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
 If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ti unirai alla sezione Strumenti e Servizi all'interno del Servizio Informativo Scientifico, il team responsabile delle piattaforme che alimentano la scoperta scientifica e aprono l'accesso attraverso la comunità di Fisica ad Alta Energia. I nostri sistemi includono INSPIRE, l'hub della letteratura globale per la fisica delle particelle; SCOAP3, che finanzia e traccia la pubblicazione di accesso aperto; CERN Analysis Preservation, che salvaguarda le analisi dietro i risultati della fisica; e uno strumento che facilita l'accesso alla memoria istituzionale del CERN.
Come Backend Python Engineer progetta, costruisce e gestisce i servizi che ingeriscono, curano, ricercano ed espongono milioni di record scientifici a un pubblico mondiale. Potrai lavorare su pipeline di dati ad alto rendimento, API REST, infrastrutture di ricerca e l'integrazione di recupero guidato AI nei sistemi di produzione. Il vostro codice sarà open source e utilizzato ogni giorno dai ricercatori attraverso centinaia di istituti.
Nell'ambito del team Strumenti e Servizi, guiderai l'ammodernamento e l'evoluzione della piattaforma di contenuti del Servizio informazioni Scientifico. Avanzerai i servizi di backend dietro INSPIRE, SCOAP3 e CERN Analysis Preservation, espanderai i servizi di Model Context Protocol che aprono il contenuto scientifico del team ai clienti AI e valuterai l'armonizzazione del backend INSPIRE con il nuovo stack backoffice. Si tratta di un progetto definito per rafforzare la scoperta della piattaforma, l'interoperabilità e l'accesso guidato AI.
Le tue responsabilità

• La responsabilità principale di questa posizione è quella di guidare la modernizzazione del backend INSPIRE, espandere i servizi del Team Model Context Protocol e allineare i servizi di digitalizzazione e archiviazione con lo stack tecnologico del team, offrendo una migrazione su larga scala al servizio Access to Memory (AtoM).
INSPIRE backend e armonizzazione:

• Rivedere i restanti raccolti personalizzati, circa 1000, e migrare quelli che dovrebbero essere conservati a Apache Airflow, ritirare o ridisegnare il resto.

• Lavorare con i curatori durante tutto per decidere cosa tenere, e automatizzare la pipeline in cui la valutazione mostra che aggiunge valore, mantenendo un umano in loop per le decisioni che richiedono giudizio esperto.

• Coinvolgere le pipeline di ingestione e curazione di Apache Airflow che elaborano metadati scientifici e testo completo in scala, migliorando la qualità dei dati, la deduplica, l'arricchimento e la copertura sorgente.
Accesso AI e interoperabilità:

• Espandi i servizi del Team Model Context Protocol su INSPIRE, la biblioteca e altri servizi di squadra, spostandoli dal pilota ad un'interfaccia coerente, documentata e manutenbile che apre contenuti scientifici curati ai client AI esterni.

• Sviluppare e ottimizzare la funzionalità di ricerca e scoperta su OpenSearch che supporta queste funzionalità, comprese le strategie di tuning e indicizzazione di rilevanza.
Servizi di digitalizzazione e archiviazione:

• Allineare i servizi di digitalizzazione e archiviazione con lo stack tecnologico del team, modernizzandoli su strutture comuni e strumenti di distribuzione.

• Fornire e supervisionare la migrazione di 35 000 nuovi oggetti di archivio al servizio Access to Memory (AtoM) nel 2027, mantenendo metadati coerenti e qualità dei dati in tutto.

• Sviluppare e automatizzare la connessione tra i servizi collegati, consentendo al contenuto di scorrere in modo affidabile attraverso la digitalizzazione e i sistemi di archiviazione.

• Preparare le tubazioni di ingestione per la nuova ingestione dei file, armonizzandoli con le altre applicazioni del team.
Fondamenti di ingegneria:

• Progettare, documentare e fornire API REST consumate da applicazioni interne, istituti partner e strumenti di terze parti.

• Applicare test automatizzati, revisione del codice, monitoraggio e CI e CD, e supportare la produzione attraverso implementazioni containerizzate e tuning delle prestazioni.

• Contribuisci i risultati del team alla comunità open source per avanzare Open Science.
Il tuo profilo

• Dimostrati servizi di building experience e backend operativi in Python in un ambiente di produzione. Solid track record con framework web come Django, Flask o FastAPI e con database relazionali e documentali.

• Mani sull'esperienza nella progettazione delle API REST.

• Esperienza pratica con motori di ricerca come OpenSearch, tra cui indicizzazione e pertinenza tuning.

• Familiarità con distribuzioni containerizzate, controllo delle versioni con flussi di lavoro Git e CI e CD.

• L'esperienza che contribuisce a progetti open source e lavorare in un team di ingegneria collaborativa è molto apprezzata.
Competenze

• Forte competenza in Python e moderne pratiche di sviluppo backend, tra cui quadri come Django, Flask e FastAPI.

• Solida comprensione del design REST API, programmazione asincrona e test software.

• Esperienza con i data stores SQL come PostgreSQL e con tecnologie di ricerca come OpenSearch.

• Conoscenze di lavoro di Docker, Kubernetes e CI e CD pipelines.

• Comprendere gli standard dei metadati e l'elaborazione dei dati su larga scala.

• Capacità di scrivere codice pulito, ben documentato e manutenbile.

descriptionByLocale.en:
You will join the Tools and Services section within the Scientific Information Service, the team responsible for the platforms that power scientific discovery and open access across the High Energy Physics community. Our systems include INSPIRE, the global literature hub for particle physics; SCOAP3, which funds and tracks open access publishing; CERN Analysis Preservation, which safeguards the analyses behind physics results; and a tool facilitating access to CERN's institutional memory.
As a Backend Python Engineer you will design, build and operate the services that ingest, curate, search and expose millions of scientific records to a worldwide audience. You will work on high throughput data pipelines, REST APIs, search infrastructure and the integration of AI driven retrieval into production systems. Your code will be open source and used daily by researchers across hundreds of institutes.
As part of the Tools and Services team, you will drive the modernisation and evolution of the Scientific Information Service content platform. You will advance the backend services behind INSPIRE, SCOAP3 and CERN Analysis Preservation, expand Model Context Protocol services that open the team's scientific content to AI clients, and evaluate the harmonisation of the INSPIRE backend with the newer backoffice stack. This is a defined project to strengthen the platform's discovery, interoperability and AI driven access.
Your responsibilities

• The core responsibility of this position is to drive the modernisation of the INSPIRE backend, expand the team's Model Context Protocol services, and align the digitisation and archival services with the team's technology stack, delivering a large scale migration to the Access to Memory (AtoM) service.
INSPIRE backend and harmonisation:

• Review the remaining custom harvests, approximately 1000, and migrate those that should be retained to Apache Airflow, retiring or redesigning the rest.

• Work with curators throughout to decide what to keep, and automate the pipeline where evaluation shows it adds value, keeping a human in the loop for decisions that require expert judgement.

• Evolve the Apache Airflow ingestion and curation pipelines that process scientific metadata and full text at scale, improving data quality, deduplication, enrichment and source coverage.
AI access and interoperability:

• Expand the team's Model Context Protocol services across INSPIRE, the library and other team services, moving them from pilot to a consistent, documented and maintainable interface that opens curated scientific content to external AI clients.

• Develop and optimise the search and discovery functionality on OpenSearch that underpins these features, including relevance tuning and indexing strategies.
Digitisation and archival services:

• Align the digitisation and archival services with the team's technology stack, modernising them onto common frameworks and deployment tooling.

• Deliver and oversee the migration of 35 000 new archival items to the Access to Memory (AtoM) service across 2027, maintaining consistent metadata and data quality throughout.

• Develop and automate the connection between the connected services, enabling content to flow reliably across the digitisation and archival systems.

• Prepare the ingestion pipelines for new file ingestion, harmonising them with the team's other applications.
Engineering foundations:

• Design, document and deliver REST APIs consumed by internal applications, partner institutes and third party tools.

• Apply automated testing, code review, monitoring and CI and CD, and support production through containerised deployments and performance tuning.

• Contribute the team's outputs back to the open source community to advance Open Science.
Your profile

• Demonstrated experience building and operating backend services in Python in a production environment. Solid track record with web frameworks such as Django, Flask or FastAPI and with relational and document databases.

• Hands on experience designing REST APIs.

• Practical experience with search engines such as OpenSearch, including indexing and relevance tuning.

• Familiarity with containerised deployments, version control with Git and CI and CD workflows.

• Experience contributing to open source projects and working in a collaborative engineering team is highly valued.
Skills

• Strong proficiency in Python and modern backend development practices, including frameworks such as Django, Flask and FastAPI.

• Solid understanding of REST API design, asynchronous programming and software testing.

• Experience with SQL data stores such as PostgreSQL and with search technologies such as OpenSearch.

• Working knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes and CI and CD pipelines.

• Understanding metadata standards and large scale data processing.

• Ability to write clean, well documented and maintainable code.

• Strong problem solving skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to work in a multicultural team and a collaborative, ownership driven mindset.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You have a professional background in Computer Science (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Job flexibility: Hybrid

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend between 6372-7004 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.

At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!

Sie werden dem Bereich Tools und Services innerhalb des Scientific Information Service beitreten, dem Team, das für die Plattformen verantwortlich ist, die wissenschaftliche Entdeckung und freien Zugang in der High Energy Physics Community ermöglichen. Unsere Systeme umfassen INSPIRE, das globale Literaturzentrum für Teilchenphysik; SCOAP3, das Open-Access-Publishing finanziert und verfolgt; CERN Analysis Preservation, das die Analysen hinter den physikalischen Ergebnissen schützt; und ein Tool, das den Zugang zum institutionellen Gedächtnis des CERN erleichtert.
Als Backend-Python-Ingenieur entwerfen, bauen und betreiben Sie die Dienste, die Millionen von wissenschaftlichen Aufzeichnungen aufnehmen, kuratieren, suchen und einem weltweiten Publikum zugänglich machen. Sie arbeiten an Datenpipelines mit hohem Durchsatz, REST-APIs, Suchinfrastruktur und der Integration von KI-gesteuertem Abruf in Produktionssysteme. Ihr Code wird Open Source sein und täglich von Forschern in Hunderten von Instituten verwendet.

INSPIRE Backend und Harmonisierung:

• Überprüfen Sie die verbleibenden benutzerdefinierten Ernten, etwa 1000, und migrieren Sie diejenigen, die beibehalten werden sollten, zu Apache Airflow, wobei Sie den Rest zurückziehen oder neu gestalten.

• Entwickeln Sie die Apache Airflow Aufnahme- und Kurationspipelines, die wissenschaftliche Metadaten und Volltext in großem Maßstab verarbeiten, wodurch die Datenqualität, Deduplizierung, Anreicherung und Quellenabdeckung verbessert werden.
KI-Zugang und Interoperabilität:

• Erweitern Sie die Model Context Protocol-Dienste des Teams auf INSPIRE, die Bibliothek und andere Teamdienste und verschieben Sie sie vom Pilot auf eine konsistente, dokumentierte und wartbare Schnittstelle, die kuratierte wissenschaftliche Inhalte für externe KI-Clients öffnet.

• Entwickeln und optimieren Sie die Such- und Suchfunktionalität auf OpenSearch, die diese Funktionen unterstützt, einschließlich Relevanz-Tuning- und Indexierungsstrategien.
Digitalisierung und Archivierung:

• Ausrichtung der Digitalisierungs- und Archivierungsdienste auf den Technologie-Stack des Teams, Modernisierung auf gemeinsame Frameworks und Bereitstellungstools.

• Bereitstellung und Überwachung der Migration von 35 000 neuen Archivobjekten zum Access to Memory (AtoM)-Dienst im Laufe des Jahres 2027 unter Beibehaltung einer konsistenten Metadaten- und Datenqualität.

• Entwickeln und automatisieren Sie die Verbindung zwischen den verbundenen Diensten, damit Inhalte zuverlässig über die Digitalisierungs- und Archivierungssysteme fließen können.

• Bereiten Sie die Aufnahme-Pipelines für die neue Dateiaufnahme vor und harmonisieren Sie sie mit den anderen Anwendungen des Teams.
Ingenieurgrundlagen:

• Design, Dokumentierung und Bereitstellung von REST-APIs, die von internen Anwendungen, Partnerinstituten und Tools von Drittanbietern genutzt werden.

• Automatisiertes Testen, Code Review, Monitoring und CI und CD anwenden und die Produktion durch containerisierte Bereitstellungen und Performance-Tuning unterstützen.

• Bringen Sie die Ergebnisse des Teams zurück in die Open-Source-Community, um Open Science voranzubringen.
Dein Profil

• Demonstrierte Erfahrung beim Aufbau und Betrieb von Backend-Services in Python in einer Produktionsumgebung. Solide Erfolgsbilanz mit Web-Frameworks wie Django, Flask oder FastAPI und mit relationalen und Dokumentendatenbanken.

Fähigkeiten

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Vous rejoindrez la section Outils et services du Service d'information scientifique, l'équipe responsable des plateformes qui alimentent la découverte scientifique et l'accès libre dans la communauté de la physique en haute énergie. Nos systèmes comprennent INSPIRE, le pôle mondial de la littérature pour la physique des particules; SCOAP3, qui finance et suit l'édition en libre accès; CERN Analysis Preservation, qui protège les analyses derrière les résultats de la physique; et un outil facilitant l'accès à la mémoire institutionnelle du CERN.
En tant que Backend Python Engineer, vous concevez, construisez et exploitez les services qui ingèrent, curent, recherchent et exposent des millions de documents scientifiques à un public mondial. Vous travaillerez sur les pipelines de données à haut débit, les API REST, l'infrastructure de recherche et l'intégration de la récupération par l'IA dans les systèmes de production. Votre code sera open source et utilisé quotidiennement par des chercheurs de centaines d'instituts.
Dans le cadre de l'équipe Outils et Services, vous piloterez la modernisation et l'évolution de la plateforme de contenu du Service d'information scientifique. Vous avancerez les services de backend derrière INSPIRE, SCOAP3 et CERN Analysis Preservation, développerez les services Model Context Protocol qui ouvrent le contenu scientifique de l'équipe aux clients AI, et évaluerez l'harmonisation du backend INSPIRE avec la nouvelle pile backoffice. Il s'agit d'un projet défini pour renforcer la découverte, l'interopérabilité et l'accès à l'IA de la plateforme.
Vos responsabilités

• La responsabilité principale de ce poste est de piloter la modernisation du moteur INSPIRE, d'élargir les services de protocole de contexte modèle de l'équipe et d'aligner les services de numérisation et d'archivage sur la pile technologique de l'équipe, en assurant une migration à grande échelle vers le service Accès à la mémoire (AtoM).
INSPIRE moteur et harmonisation:

• Examinez les autres récoltes sur mesure, environ 1000, et migrez celles qui devraient être conservées à Apache Airflow, en prenant sa retraite ou en repensant le reste.

• Travailler avec les conservateurs tout au long pour décider ce qu'il faut garder, et automatiser le pipeline où l'évaluation montre qu'il ajoute de la valeur, en maintenant un humain dans la boucle pour les décisions qui exigent un jugement expert.

• Évoluer les pipelines d'ingestion et de curation d'air Apache qui traitent les métadonnées scientifiques et le texte intégral à l'échelle, améliorant la qualité des données, la duplication, l'enrichissement et la couverture des sources.
Accès à l'IA et interopérabilité:

• Élargir les services du protocole de contexte modèle de l'équipe à l'ensemble de l'INSPIRE, de la bibliothèque et d'autres services de l'équipe, en les transférant du projet pilote à une interface cohérente, documentée et durable qui ouvre le contenu scientifique curé aux clients externes de l'IA.

• Développez et optimisez les fonctionnalités de recherche et de découverte sur OpenSearch qui sous-tendent ces fonctionnalités, y compris l'accord de pertinence et les stratégies d'indexation.
Services de numérisation et d'archivage:

• Aligner les services de numérisation et d'archivage sur la pile technologique de l'équipe, les moderniser sur des cadres communs et des outils de déploiement.

• Fournir et superviser la migration de 35 000 nouveaux objets d'archives vers le service Accès à la mémoire (AtoM) en 2027, en maintenant la qualité des métadonnées et des données tout au long.

• Développer et automatiser la connexion entre les services connectés, permettant ainsi au contenu de circuler de manière fiable dans les systèmes de numérisation et d'archivage.

• Préparer les pipelines d'ingestion pour l'ingestion de nouveaux dossiers, en les harmonisant avec les autres applications de l'équipe.
Fondations techniques :

• Conception, documentation et livraison des API REST consommées par les applications internes, les instituts partenaires et les outils tiers.

• Appliquer les tests automatisés, l'examen des codes, la surveillance et l'IC et le CD, et soutenir la production par des déploiements containerizzato et le réglage des performances.

• Contribuer les extrants de l'équipe à la communauté open source pour faire progresser la science ouverte.
Votre profil

• Expérience démontrée construction et exploitation de services de backend en Python dans un environnement de production. Un bilan solide avec des cadres Web tels que Django, Flask ou FastAPI et avec des bases de données relationnelles et documentaires.

• Mains sur l'expérience de conception des API REST.

• Expérience pratique avec les moteurs de recherche tels que OpenSearch, y compris l'indexation et la pertinence.

• Familiarité avec les déploiements containerizzato, contrôle de version avec les flux de travail Git et CI et CD.

• L'expérience qui a contribué aux projets open source et qui a travaillé dans une équipe d'ingénierie collaborative est très appréciée.
Compétences

• Forte compétence en Python et les pratiques modernes de développement de backend, y compris des cadres tels que Django, Flask et FastAPI.

• Une bonne compréhension de la conception de l'API REST, de la programmation asynchrone et des tests logiciels.

• Expérience avec des magasins de données SQL comme PostgreSQLTM et avec des technologies de recherche comme OpenSearch.

• Connaissance pratique des pipelines Docker, Kubernetes et CI et CD.

• Comprendre les normes de métadonnées et le traitement à grande échelle des données.

• Capacité d'écrire un code propre, bien documenté et à jour.

• Compétences solides en résolution de problèmes et attention aux détails.

• Capacité de travailler dans une équipe multiculturelle et dans une mentalité collaborative et axée sur la propriété.

• Anglais parlé et écrit, avec un engagement à apprendre le français.

• Vous êtes ressortissant d'un État membre ou associé du CERN .

• Vous avez une formation professionnelle en informatique (ou dans un domaine connexe) et avez :
• une maîtrise de 2 à 6 ans d'expérience professionnelle après l'obtention du diplôme;

• ou d'un doctorat d'une durée maximale de 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle après l'obtention du diplôme.

 You will provide expert legal advice on international administrative law and personnel matters, supporting the development and application of CERN's internal legal framework, HR policies and procedures, while contributing to the fair and effective resolution of internal disputes and disciplinary matters.

• Play a key role in working groups for the review of internal legislation.

• Draft internal legislation and related amendments.

• Provide legal advice to the HR Management and other stakeholders on:
• The application of the Staff Rules and Regulations and related documents.

• HR policy matters and procedures.

•  Internal disputes and disciplinary proceedings.

• Handle cases on behalf of the Organization before CERN’s internal dispute resolution and advisory  boards.

• Perform legal research and analysis for the preparation of legal opinions, internal memoranda or official correspondence.

• Demonstrated experience as a legal adviser in an intergovernmental organisation, practicing international administrative law.

• Knowledge of International Administrative Law (law of the International Civil Service).

jobs.title: Junior Mechanical Engineer (SY-ABT-MDD-2026-188-GRAE)
jobs.description:
As a Mechanical Engineer, you will join the Mechanics, Development and Design (MDD) section, where you will contribute to the design and development of advanced electromechanical systems for accelerator beam transfer across the entire CERN accelerator complex. Working alongside experienced engineers, physicists and technicians, you will help develop innovative equipment used in a world-leading scientific research environment.
 Your responsibilities:

• Contribute to the conceptual design and development of mechanical and electromechanical systems.

• Produce engineering documentation, including 3D models, manufacturing drawings and Bills of Materials (BOMs).

• Support the manufacturing, assembly, testing and installation of equipment.

• Collaborate with physicists, engineers and technicians to translate conceptual requirements into practical engineering solutions.

• Participate in the development of innovative technologies for high-voltage pulsed power and accelerator systems.
 Your profile:

• Initial experience designing mechanical components and assemblies using 3D CAD software (CATIA V5 is an advantage).

• Exposure to ISO GPS standards and BOM preparation.

• Hands-on experience in structural simulations using finite element analysis.

• Theoretical knowledge in mechanical behaviour of materials and production methods.

• Experience with additive manufacturing and 3D scanning would be an asset.
 Skills:

• Knowledge of structural analysis using finite element methods.

• Ability to work in an international multi-disciplinary team with physicists, engineers and technicians.

• Skills to prepare comprehensive technical documentation.

• Experience with FEA software is an advantage

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
 Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Mechanical Engineering (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants without University degree are not eligible.

• Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

Job closing date: 06.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
 Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
 Working hours: 40 hours per week
 Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
 Target start date: 01-October-2026
 This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.
 Job reference: SY-ABT-MDD-2026-188-GRAE
 Field of work: Mechanical Engineering
 Benchmark job: 200090 - Mechanical Engineer

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend between 5266-5793 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Come ingegnere meccanico, si unirà alla sezione Meccanica, Sviluppo e Design (MDD), dove si contribuirà alla progettazione e sviluppo di sistemi elettromeccanici avanzati per il trasferimento del fascio acceleratore attraverso l'intero complesso dell'acceleratore CERN. Lavorando insieme a esperti ingegneri, fisici e tecnici, vi aiuterà a sviluppare attrezzature innovative utilizzate in un ambiente di ricerca scientifica leader mondiale.
Le tue responsabilità:

• Contribuire alla progettazione concettuale e allo sviluppo di sistemi meccanici ed elettromeccanici.

• Produci la documentazione di ingegneria, compresi i modelli 3D, disegni di fabbricazione e fatture di materiali (BOMs).

• Sostenere la produzione, il montaggio, il test e l'installazione di attrezzature.

• Collaborare con fisici, ingegneri e tecnici per tradurre requisiti concettuali in soluzioni ingegneristiche pratiche.

• Partecipa allo sviluppo di tecnologie innovative per sistemi di potenza e acceleratore ad alta tensione.
Il tuo profilo:

• Esperienza iniziale che progetta componenti e assemblaggi meccanici utilizzando il software CAD 3D (CATIA V5 è un vantaggio).

• Esposizione agli standard GPS ISO e preparazione BOM.

• Esperienza pratica nelle simulazioni strutturali mediante analisi degli elementi finiti.

• Conoscenza teorica nel comportamento meccanico dei materiali e dei metodi di produzione.

• Esperienza con produzione additiva e scansione 3D sarebbe un bene.
Competenze:

• Conoscenza dell'analisi strutturale utilizzando metodi di elementi finiti.

• Capacità di lavorare in un team multidisciplinare internazionale con fisici, ingegneri e tecnici.

• Competenze per preparare una documentazione tecnica completa.

• L'esperienza con il software FEA è un vantaggio

• Parlato e scritto inglese, con un impegno per imparare il francese.
Criteri di ammissibilità:

• Sei un cittadino di uno Stato membro del CERN o di uno Stato membro associato .

• Con la scadenza dell'applicazione, si dispone di un massimo di due anni di esperienza professionale dalla laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica (o un campo correlato) e la vostra più alta qualifica educativa è sia una laurea o master.

• Non hai mai avuto un contratto di laurea o di socio del CERN.

• I candidati senza laurea non sono ammissibili.

• I candidati con un dottorato non sono ammissibili.

Data di chiusura del lavoro: 06.08.2026 alle 23:59 CEST.
Durata del contratto: 24 mesi, con una possibile estensione fino a 36 mesi massimo.
Orario di lavoro: 40 ore settimanali
Flessibilità del lavoro: Fully Onsite
Data di inizio obiettivo: 01-ottobre-2026
Questa posizione comporta:

• Lavoro nelle aree di radiazione.

• Interventi in impianti sotterranei.
Riferimento del lavoro: SY-ABT-MDD-2026-188-GRAE
Campo di lavoro: Ingegneria meccanica
Lavoro Benchmark: 200090 - Ingegnere meccanico

Vantaggi globali

• Una spesa mensile tra 5266-5793 Franco Svizzero al mese (gratuito dalla tassa) a seconda della laurea.

• 30 giorni di congedo retribuito all'anno più 2 settimane di chiusura annuale.

• Copertura dell’assicurazione sanitaria completa del CERN (per te, il tuo coniuge e i tuoi figli) e dell’iscrizione al CERN Pension Fund.

• Indennità mensili di famiglia, bambino e bambino a seconda delle circostanze individuali.

• Un pacchetto di trasferimento (concessione di installazione e spese di viaggio) a seconda delle vostre circostanze individuali.

• Possibilità di estendere il contratto fino a 36 mesi.

• On-the-job e formazione formale, comprese le lezioni di lingua.
Panoramica del CERN - Scopri un mondo in cui l'impossibile è reso possibile!
Al CERN, l'Organizzazione europea per la ricerca nucleare, stiamo spingendo le frontiere della scienza e della tecnologia. Il nostro lavoro innovativo riunisce non solo i fisici, ma anche una vasta gamma di professionisti provenienti da settori ingegneristici, tecnici, scientifici e amministrativi. Insieme, promuoviamo un ambiente in cui l'innovazione e la collaborazione prosperano.
Ogni giorno affrontiamo nuove entusiasmanti sfide e opportunità per contribuire alla ricerca all'avanguardia che plasma la nostra comprensione dell'universo. Incontriamo queste sfide attraverso le diverse prospettive all'interno dei nostri team, assicurando che ogni contributo sia valutato e guida il nostro senso condiviso di inclusione e scopo. La diversità è un valore fondamentale del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione, e rimane centrale per la nostra missione e il successo continuo.
Se siete pronti a far parte di una comunità dinamica e inclusiva che spinge i confini della conoscenza, il CERN è il luogo in cui la vostra curiosità e abilità possono prosperare. Fate parte della nostra missione per scoprire cosa sta nel cuore dell'universo! Partita!

Als Maschinenbauingenieur treten Sie der Sektion Mechanik, Entwicklung und Design (MDD) bei, wo Sie zum Design und zur Entwicklung fortschrittlicher elektromechanischer Systeme für den Beschleunigerstrahltransfer über den gesamten CERN-Beschleunigerkomplex beitragen. In Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Ingenieuren, Physikern und Technikern helfen Sie bei der Entwicklung innovativer Geräte, die in einer weltweit führenden wissenschaftlichen Forschungsumgebung eingesetzt werden.
Ihre Aufgaben:

• Beitrag zur Konzeption und Entwicklung von mechanischen und elektromechanischen Systemen.

• Erstellen Sie technische Dokumentation, einschließlich 3D-Modelle, Fertigungszeichnungen und Stücklisten (BOMs).
